Here's everything I can see in your fridge! 🧺 Before I suggest tonight's dinner, let me do my usual check-in:

> 🔍 **Did I miss anything?** Are there items in closed containers or the door shelves I couldn't see? Is anything nearly finished I shouldn't rely on — like the eggs, feta, or OJ?

---

## 🧊 What's in Your Fridge

| Section | Ingredients |
|---|---|
| 🥬 Leafy & Fresh | Butter lettuce, spinach/chard, fresh parsley |
| 🥦 Vegetables | Broccoli, red cabbage, white/napa cabbage, kohlrabi, watermelon radish *(use soon!)*, beetroot, baby carrots, green bell pepper |
| 🧀 Dairy | Feta cheese, butter, eggs (6–8) |
| 🫙 Preserved | Tomato sauce (2 jars), passata (1 large jar), olives/preserved fruit, small dark condiment jar |
| 🍋 Fresh | Lemons (2–3), orange juice *(use soon!)* |

---

## 🍽️ Tonight's Dinner — Family-Tailored Suggestions

I've kept in mind: **your Type 2 diabetes** (low GI, low sugar), **your wife's vegetarianism**, and your **Indian & Chinese cuisine preferences**. Since there's no chicken visible in the fridge right now, tonight's options are vegetarian-friendly for the whole family — great news for your wife! 🌿

---

### 🥚 1. Indian Masala Shakshuka *(Eggs in Spiced Tomato Sauce)*
**Uses:** Eggs, passata/tomato sauce, spinach, green pepper, parsley, feta, lemon
A desi twist on shakshuka — spice up the tomato base with cumin, turmeric, and garam masala (if you have them in your pantry), add wilted spinach and green pepper, then poach eggs right in the sauce. Top with crumbled feta and parsley.
- ✅ Low GI for you
- ✅ Vegetarian for your wife
- ✅ Eggs — the girls will love it!
- ⏱ ~20 mins

---

### 🥦 2. Chinese-Style Stir-Fried Broccoli & Cabbage with Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
**Uses:** Broccoli, red/white cabbage, carrots, green pepper, eggs, lemon
Stir-fry the veggies in butter with soy sauce (if available), a squeeze of lemon, and toss through scrambled egg. Serve with cauliflower rice instead of white rice to keep it low GI for you.
- ✅ Low GI (cauliflower rice swap)
- ✅ Vegetarian for your wife
- ✅ Egg-packed — the girls will be happy!
- ⏱ ~25 mins

---

### 🥗 3. Indian Spiced Roasted Veggie Bowl with Feta
**Uses:** Beetroot, carrots, kohlrabi, broccoli, spinach, feta, lemon, parsley
Toss the veggies in Indian spices (cumin, coriander, turmeric) and roast until golden. Serve over fresh spinach and butter lettuce with crumbled feta and a lemon dressing.
- ✅ Low GI, high fibre — excellent for Type 2
- ✅ Vegetarian for everyone
- ⏱ ~30 mins

---

### 🌟 My Top Pick Tonight
Go for the **Indian Masala Shakshuka** 🍅🥚 — it's fast, uses your passata and spinach that need to be eaten soon, has a lovely Indian flavour profile, and the whole family can enjoy it together. The girls get their eggs, your wife gets a meat-free meal, and it's naturally low GI for you!

---

Would you like a **full recipe** for any of these, or shall I use this fridge inventory to plan your **whole week of meals**? 😊
